WITH date_dim_1998 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
),
web_sales_1998 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk,
           ws.ws_order_number,
           ws.ws_quantity,
           ws.ws_sales_price,
           ws.ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim_1998 d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
),
web_returns_base AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk,
           wr.wr_order_number,
           wr.wr_refunded_cash,
           wr.wr_fee,
           r.r_reason_desc,
           cd1.cd_marital_status AS refunded_marital_status,
           cd1.cd_education_status AS refunded_education_status,
           cd2.cd_marital_status AS returning_marital_status,
           cd2.cd_education_status AS returning_education_status,
           ca.ca_state
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
          AND ( (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary')
             OR (cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
             OR (cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree') )
    ) cd1 ON true
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
          AND ( (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary')
             OR (cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
             OR (cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree') )
    ) cd2 ON true
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT ca_state
        FROM customer_address
        WHERE ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
          AND ca_country = 'United States'
          AND ca_state IN ('NC','TX','IA','WI','WV','GA','OK','VA','KY')
    ) ca ON true
),
sales_returns_base AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws.ws_quantity,
           ws.ws_sales_price,
           ws.ws_net_profit,
           wr.wr_refunded_cash,
           wr.wr_fee,
           wr.refunded_marital_status,
           wr.refunded_education_status,
           wr.returning_marital_status,
           wr.returning_education_status,
           wr.ca_state,
           wr.r_reason_desc
    FROM web_sales_1998 ws
    JOIN web_returns_base wr
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
     AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
),

    SELECT refunded_marital_status,

           COUNT(ws_quantity) AS cnt_q,
           SUM(ws_quantity) AS sum_q,

           SUM(wr_refunded_cash) AS sum_cash,
           COUNT(wr_fee) AS cnt_fee,
           SUM(wr_fee) AS sum_fee
